core_obligations: Retain exact Rank target and word/probe parameter assumptions.
Preserve full author separator, comet and conditional entropy support.
Retain complete author Lemma23 including prefix quantile, Pinsker and binomial-tail calculations.
difficulty_reason: The author combines a controlled-entropy sampling restriction with disjoint comets to locate a block whose bits retain high conditional entropy even given their prefix. A quantitative tail argument in the complete Lemma23 forces correlated rank answers, contradicting almost pairwise independence. The conditional-prefix entropy mechanism differs substantively from colored predecessor.
